title: DuDoRNet: Learning a Dual-Domain Recurrent Network for Fast MRI Reconstruction with Deep T1 Prior
layout_note: Very wide, short strip: Zero-Padding Reconstruction enters at the left, then repeated recurrent blocks (1st … Nth, ellipsis between) each run image-domain input → image network → FT|DC → k-space input → k-space network → DC|IFT. A prior-data box at the upper left splits into 'kspace' and 'image' boxes whose long feed lines run along the top and drop into the matching inputs; a grey 'Sampled k-space' box at the lower left sends a thin line under the row up into each DC.
grouping: Each recurrent block sits in a dashed grey rounded container labelled in bold below its left corner (1st Recurrent Block, Nth Recurrent Block). Colour families mark the domain: green for the image-domain network (filled) and its input (green outline) and the green image-prior line; orange for the k-space network, its input and the orange k-space-prior line; grey fill for DC and for the measured k-space; one blue box for the output.
shapes_depth: Flat square-cornered boxes with thin outlines; transforms (FT, IFT) and DC are small boxes abutting each other as one split box (FT|DC, DC|IFT). Thin orthogonal connector lines; a dotted arrow between stages. No images or tensors.
proposed_highlight: The two learned networks are the only solid-coloured boxes (green iDRD-Net, orange kDRD-Net) with the domain letter in bold (i, k); every other box is white or grey.
lesson: Colour names the domain, not the module type: green for everything in image space, orange for everything in k-space, and the prior's two feed lines carry the colour of the input they enter.
notes: venue CVPR 2020 from the arXiv comment ('CVPR2020'). Sans-serif labels with subscripts (Input_i1, Input_kn).

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)
